name: Nvidia 3D Vision
summary: Nvidia's proprietary stereoscopic ecosystem using active-shutter glasses, an IR emitter, and a dedicated stereo driver. Supported automatic 3D conversion for hundreds of DX9/10/11 games. Two modes: 3D Vision (120Hz DVI/DP monitor) and 3DTV Play (HDMI 1.4 3DTV).
compatibility_notes: Official support ended April 2019 with driver 425.31. RTX 30-series and newer GPUs lack the 3D controller hardware code entirely. RTX 20-series is the last generation with functional (if unsupported) 3D Vision capability on driver 425.31. Requires Windows 10 1909 or older. Community successor is Geo-11.
hardware_requirements: Nvidia GPU: GTX 10-series or older (full), RTX 20-series (limited, driver 425.31 only)
3D Vision glasses kit (active shutter + IR emitter)
